# Getting help with Faber

- **Questions and ideas:** start a [discussion](https://github.com/startRED/faber/discussions).
- **Bugs:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/startRED/faber/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) and include the
  steps to repeat it.
- **Security problems:** report them privately, as [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) describes. Never open a public issue
  or pull request for one.

Faber is maintained by one person. There is no paid support and no guaranteed response time.
